sample_unit: children (17-36 months) at pediatric well-child visits
models_evaluated: digital phenotyping app algorithm (computer vision and machine learning)

links.outcome: Sensitivity of autism screening algorithm across sex, race and ethnicity subgroups
links.effect: Overall AUC 0.90, sensitivity 87.8%, specificity 80.8%, NPV 97.8%, PPV 40.6%; sensitivity was similar across subgroups defined by sex, race and ethnicity.
links.quote: The algorithm had similar sensitivity performance across subgroups as defined by sex, race and ethnicity.

unlisted_practices: Combining AI digital phenotyping results with caregiver questionnaires to increase screening accuracy

screen.reason: Prospective clinical evaluation of a computer vision and machine learning digital screening tool for autism administered during pediatric well-child visits, including subgroup performance evaluation across sex, race, and ethnicity.
